text:
sara: Heads-up — staging canary shows a flurry of reconnects after the telemetry sampling change. clients hit resume, then immediately reconnect a few seconds later, and billing shows duplicate token charges :thinking_face:
kevin: yep saw that alert. proxy returns 204 for some streamed requests and the client treats it as EOF, triggers reconnect. resume_token changes on reconnect, billing thinks it's a new session so we double-charge. grabbing proxy logs now.
maria: is this related to the sampling toggles for keepalive events? we sampled heartbeat events at 10% to cut telemetry cost last week.
alex: we added sampling at the edge to drop heartbeat traces, but i didn't expect it to strip the X-RW-Resume header. if that header gets dropped then the router assumes no resume token and allocates a fresh session id.
juan: that would explain duplicate billing. propose two immediate options: 1) guarantee certain headers (X-RW-Resume, X-RW-Alive) are always forwarded even when sampled, or 2) make billing idempotent by resume_token fingerprinting for a 60s window.
sara: quick workaround patch in staging: middleware preserves resume header regardless of sampling. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/edge/pulls/482 :thumbsup:
kevin: long term i prefer dedupe at billing service. middleware-preserve is bandaid and can be missed by other proxies. dedupe logic: if resume_token == last_seen && origin_fingerprint == same && last_seen_ts < 60s -> ignore charge.
maria: console/telemetry UX concern: the metrics spike and then drop, but users see billing anomalies in the console. we should surface when dedupe happens vs real new sessions. right now console shows only "reconnects" count.
alex: agree — add a low-card telemetry event resume_dedupe that the billing service emits. sample it 100% for the canary rollout so we can verify without overwhelming storage.
ops-bot: deploy bot: canary rollout edge/2026-03-18-telemetry-sample completed (3/3 hosts). No alerts muted.
sara: rolling the preserve-header patch to canary now. also enabling 100% resume_dedupe events for 12h. will watch for false positives.
tyler: logging snippet of the problem (from staging):
```
[2026-03-19T15:02:11Z] proxy: conn=5344 method=GET path=/stream status=204 resume_token=abc123 sample=0
[2026-03-19T15:02:12Z] client: reconnecting cause=unexpected-eof last_resume=abc123 new_resume=def456
[2026-03-19T15:02:12Z] billing: charge_attempt token=def456 amount=0.00012 usd
```
juan: if we do 60s fingerprint dedupe we need to be careful with multi-tenant clients behind NAT — use origin_fingerprint (api_key + ip + user_agent hash) not raw ip.
maria: adding a console annotation to mark the canary window and a flag to show "deduped resumes" in the session timeline. UX will default to "show on hover" so it's not noisy.
kevin: also adding a small telemetry counter for dropped_heartbeat_headers so we can confirm middleware fix actually stops header loss.
sara: action items: 1) alex/juan middleware header preserve -> prod canary, 2) kevin billing dedupe prototype + resume_dedupe event, 3) maria console flag + annotation. i'll coordinate followups in the incident ticket.
kevin: quick note — dedupe window should be configurable via feature flag. we'll start with 60s and iterate.
sara: thanks team. i'll post followup when 100% resume_dedupe sampling has 1h of data. :rocket:
